target: React/Refine + Taruvi native data/storage/access + Python services; no Laravel/PHP
proof_boundary: Document packaging/source traceability only; no app implementation or tests.

modules.title: Dashboard
modules.scope: Permission-aware KPI cards; warehouse and currency scope; widget preferences; replenishment; recent orders; financial watch and quick actions
modules.acceptance: Dashboard numbers reconcile to source records for the selected scope; forbidden financial data is absent from the response, not merely hidden; preference changes survive reload

modules.title: Inventory / Products
modules.scope: List/filter/search/view/create/edit; SKU and barcode; prices/currencies; options/variants; images; supplier links; BOM; batch/serial tracking; stock history; privileged reset as a separate guarded operation
modules.acceptance: Create and reload a product with variants and images; preserve variant IDs on edit; edit cannot overwrite stock; removal of referenced variants follows source deactivation rules; opening quantities create ledger events

modules.title: Orders, Payments and Documents
modules.scope: Sales order create/edit/detail/list; line discounts and order totals; approval; payment/refund/void ledger; invoices; shipment links; cancel and stock consequences
modules.acceptance: Create order and verify source-accurate initial stock effect including pending approval; shipping must not deduct again; partial payments/refunds/voids reconcile outstanding balance; unauthorized/replayed commands cannot post duplicate effects

modules.title: Customers
modules.scope: Customer create/edit/list/detail; addresses and contact data; order history; contact invitations and portal relationship
modules.acceptance: Save and reload all editable fields; reject cross-organization identities; contact invitation belongs to the correct customer; customer detail links show only authorized related records

modules.title: Returns / RMA
modules.scope: Select eligible order; create return/exchange request; approval/rejection; line condition and restock choice; receive; complete; separate refund linkage
modules.acceptance: Reject quantities above eligible shipped/remaining quantities; receipt restocks only selected eligible lines; repeated receipt does not duplicate stock; completing a return does not silently refund payment

modules.title: Purchase Orders
modules.scope: Create/edit/list/detail; supplier lines and totals; approval/send lifecycle; partial receiving; warehouse/bin updates; quick reorder; price history
modules.acceptance: Receive a PO partially then finally; reject over-receiving and foreign line IDs; stock/bin/movement/price history agree; retry cannot receive twice; quick reorder creates a draft rather than purchasing goods

modules.title: Suppliers
modules.scope: Supplier create/edit/list/detail; supplier ratings and product associations; contact/address fields; purchasing history
modules.acceptance: Create and reload supplier; product association keeps supplier SKU/cost/lead time/minimum quantity; primary supplier rule is enforced; supplier detail/PO navigation respects permissions

modules.title: Approvals
modules.scope: Unified approval queue; embedded approval panels; order/PO/adjustment/transfer decisions; thresholds; reviewer/self-approval rules; notes and history
modules.acceptance: Each configured workflow enters the correct queue; reject unauthorized/self decisions when prohibited; enforce each endpoint note limit; stale/repeated decisions cannot apply stock twice; approval status is not confused with document status

modules.title: Categories
modules.scope: Category listing and modal create/edit; description and active state; related products and selection options
modules.acceptance: Required/unique/scoped fields follow source rules; save/reload reflects changes in product selectors; deletion and referenced-record restrictions match source rather than silently cascade

modules.title: Locations
modules.scope: Locations/bins; optional warehouse association; code/name/description/capacity/active state; filter and inline forms
modules.acceptance: Location belongs to the selected organization/warehouse; save persists every field; referenced-stock behavior is preserved; product primary location is not mistaken for physical stock balance

modules.title: Warehouses
modules.scope: Create/edit/list/detail; contacts/address/timezone/currency/priority/capacity/default/active; assigned users; linked locations and balances
modules.acceptance: Save/readback all fields; enforce default and assigned-user rules from source; source/destination warehouse access is distinct; switching warehouse updates scoped views without granting new authority

modules.title: Stock Adjustments
modules.scope: Adjustment list/create/detail; signed quantity delta; variant stock popup; reason/notes/location; optional approval; before/change/after history
modules.acceptance: Main form posts a signed nonzero delta; variant popup translates mode correctly including recount zero; pending approval is not shown as completed stock; insufficient available stock and stale concurrent requests fail safely

modules.title: Stock by Warehouse
modules.scope: Warehouse/bin stock view; parent-versus-variant identity; on-hand/held/available; unassigned quantities; in-transit interpretation; filters and drilldowns
modules.acceptance: Reconcile bins plus unassigned balances to on-hand; available equals on-hand less active holds; do not double count parent and variants or dispatched stock; foreign warehouse data is denied

modules.title: Stock Transfers
modules.scope: Create/list/detail; prepare/reserve; dispatch; in-transit; receipt/completion; cancellation; scanning verification
modules.acceptance: Prepare reserves; dispatch consumes holds and deducts source; receive increments destination once; shipped transfer cannot cancel; source scan checklist is client-only unless an approved enhancement changes that contract

modules.title: Stock Audits and Cycle Counts
modules.scope: Draft/create/edit/start; scoped item snapshots; count/revision history; review/recount; offline count drafts; variance posting; cycle schedules
modules.acceptance: Stale count revision is rejected; local draft survives network failure and remains tenant-scoped; required variance approval blocks completion; allow-uncounted leaves those lines unchanged; posted discrepancies apply once; due schedule avoids duplicate open audits

modules.title: Work Orders / Assembly
modules.scope: Assembly/BOM relationship; create/list/detail/start; component availability and allocation; actual output; complete/cancel
modules.acceptance: Starting does not invent a reservation absent in source; completion consumes components and produces output atomically; insufficient components roll back; source underproduction closure behavior is preserved and disclosed

modules.title: Reservations
modules.scope: Active/expired/consumed/released listing; owner/reference filters; authorized release; holds created by owning workflows rather than an invented generic form
modules.acceptance: Available stock falls while hold is active; expiration/release removes availability commitment but preserves history; serial quantity and unsupported combinations follow source; repeat consume/release cannot double-apply

modules.title: Import / Export
modules.scope: Product/order/user templates; file validation; row-level results; partial failures; historical order mode; invitation/integration flags; scoped downloads
modules.acceptance: Reject invalid file/headers/foreign identities; preserve exact accepted/rejected/skipped counts; historical order import changes no stock and emits no order-created hook; exports and downloads enforce current owner/permission scope

modules.title: Reports, Builder and Schedules
modules.scope: Built-in inventory/sales/receivables/analytics; period and grouping filters; saved report builder; preview/chart/share; export; scheduled delivery
modules.acceptance: Totals reconcile with underlying operations and currencies; capped displayed rows do not cap headline totals; shared report rechecks viewer access; scheduled recipients are reauthorized at send time; filter/export asymmetries remain explicit

modules.title: Activity Log
modules.scope: Actor/category/action/subject/date/search filters; security events; before/after expansion; export; append-only event history
modules.acceptance: Relevant mutations record actor/tenant/subject and outcomes; users cannot edit audit events; field redaction follows policy; source export omission of search/subject_type is an explicit parity decision rather than an undocumented fix

modules.title: Admin Users
modules.scope: Create/edit/list/detail; invitation/reset; role assignment; active state; warehouse assignments and protected self/admin rules
modules.acceptance: Cannot grant unheld privileges or cross-tenant roles; edit blank password retains existing credential; self/protected deletion restrictions work; invitation delivery is separately classified from account creation

modules.title: Roles and Permission Sets
modules.scope: Roles create/edit/list/detail; direct and effective permissions; permission-set API contracts; system/protected restrictions; service authorization matrix
modules.acceptance: No role grants unauthorized permissions; system roles retain protection; role create includes permission_set_ids while source edit omits it; denied direct API/datatable access remains denied even when UI is bypassed

modules.title: Authentication, Profile and Account
modules.scope: Staff login/reset/verification/confirm password; two-factor setup/challenge/recovery; profile/password; preferences and account deletion
modules.acceptance: Native identity lifecycle satisfies the documented user flows; one-use recovery/reset and revoked access work; organization switching/stale tab requests cannot cross scope; unsupported native auth features are explicit blockers, not insecure custom workarounds

modules.title: Organization, Email and Preferences
modules.scope: Organization profile/logo/region/currency/timezone; approval policies; customer portal enablement; email configuration/test; notification preferences; organization switch
modules.acceptance: Independent settings updates preserve unrelated keys; blank secrets obey source retention without being returned to browser; currency/timezone persist; email test failure is not a successful configuration claim; switches require membership

modules.title: Notifications
modules.scope: Notification list/dropdown; read/unread/type state; mark one/all; delete/clear read; action navigation; preferences
modules.acceptance: Only owner notifications are readable/mutable; mark-read completes before redirect; errors remain visible and retryable; duplicate clicks do not race state; delivery evidence distinguishes in-app creation from email delivery

modules.title: Shipping and Carrier Services
modules.scope: Shipping settings; sender address; parcel units; manual/provider shipments; rate/label flow; tracking/delivery updates; shipment items and partial fulfillment
modules.acceptance: Manual shipment persists and does not rededuct order stock; provider test mode is distinct from paid purchase; parcel units remain ounces/inches; purchased/provider status requires actual provider evidence; webhook replay cannot duplicate fulfillment

modules.title: Storage, Uploads and Downloads
modules.scope: Taruvi-native images/attachments/generated documents; upload validation and ownership; purpose mapping; authorized retrieval and cleanup
modules.acceptance: Enforce size/type/count and tenant ownership on server; readback after reload succeeds; inaccessible object cannot be fetched by guessed ID; failed uploads do not create false success or orphaned record references; durable identifiers are not expiring URLs

modules.title: API Tokens, Webhooks and External Interfaces
modules.scope: Scoped token creation/revocation; show secret once; webhook definitions/events/delivery/retry/rotation; REST/MCP/GraphQL source parity disposition
modules.acceptance: Tokens cannot exceed issuing user scope; secrets do not reappear in lists/logs; private/reserved webhook destinations rejected; retries reuse effect identity; external interfaces call the same Python command authorization instead of privileged bypass

modules.title: Customer Portal
modules.scope: Customer login/invite/reset; portal enablement; dashboard; own-order detail/invoice; own returns/request lifecycle
modules.acceptance: Wrong customer or organization cannot read records/documents; no invented portal checkout/create-order flow; only eligible delivered-order returns accepted; pending return causes no stock movement until authorized staff receipt

modules.title: Extensions, Plugins and Tax Documents
modules.scope: Bundled plugin controls; slots/widgets/tabs and registered contract extensions; tax profile; confirmed immutable tax invoice; administration parity disposition
modules.acceptance: Tax invoice uses validated source profile and item facts then freezes snapshot; later master-data edits do not alter issued document; no claim of legal/tax filing certification; arbitrary uploaded executable plugins are not enabled without an approved target design

modules.title: Provisioning, Updates, Backups and Recovery
modules.scope: Source installer/update/backup screens mapped to Taruvi provisioning/deployment/backup equivalents; operational permissions; restore/recovery evidence
modules.acceptance: No Laravel/PHP installer, artisan command or runtime is delivered; each source admin function has an explicit target equivalent or blocker; backup proves database/files/config scope and actual restore in approved isolated environment; no destructive recovery without approval

modules.title: Replenishment and Reorder Policies
modules.scope: Product and warehouse thresholds; variant replenishment policies; supplier/cost/currency/quantity; suggested reorder; draft PO linkage
modules.acceptance: Preserve nullable inherited thresholds; policy scope distinguishes variant/warehouse/location; suggestion uses available source inputs; repeated quick reorder behavior follows source; policy must not imply an automatic purchase without an implemented authorized workflow
